rows.en: Well then, do try to keep your wits about you!
rows.notes: Refusal path of ext_gra_002 (the player was lost); 'shikkari suru' = pull yourself together. Echoes gra_001's parting jab.

rows.en:
(This goes way beyond refreshed! I can see not just
the Macross, but the whole galaxy!!)
(I'll grab some hippo-cow ice cream on the way home!)
rows.notes: kabagyuu (hippo-cow): Frontier food animal, not in the glossary.

rows.en:
(My head feels clear, which is great, but...
something's still missing...)

rows.notes: 'ara ara, anata wa...': she recognizes the player from earlier encounters; 'again' added for the repeat meeting.

rows.en: It's not really what I'd call trouble, but...

Wait!
You don't have to say it. I know.
You want to get... refreshed, don't you?

Yes, a refresh that reaches every corner of your body...
the Full-Body Refresh.
rows.notes: Product-style name 'furu bodii sukkiri' rendered 'Full-Body Refresh'; sukkiri = 'refresh' throughout the ext_gra scenes.

rows.en: I want my whole body refreshed!

rows.notes: Muttered after the treatment; what is unusual is not said (the next line brushes it off).

rows.en: (I'll grab a hippo-cow beef bowl on the way home!)
Wh-what the...? My body feels weird...

I c-can't lift my arms...
I'm even worn out just standing here...
Hmm, so this time it really did fail...
rows.notes: Subject of 'shippai' (the treatment / her people) left implicit as 'it', as in gra_001 where she lets slip 'those guys failed'.

rows.en: Okay, I'll just walk home somehow.
rows.notes: Refusal path; 'tekitou ni aruite kaerimasu' = find my own way home on foot.

rows.en:
(My head feels clear, which is great, but...
something's still missing...)
(I'll grab a hippo-cow beef bowl on the way home!)

rows.notes: Who said so is not stated ('tte hanashi'); used in 10 places, kept impersonal.

rows.en:
Hey, \p.
So you finally showed up...

rows.notes: 'koe ga chiisai zo' = your voice is too quiet; drill-sergeant idiom.

rows.en:
Don't make me repeat myself!
I can't hear you!!

...Good.
You know why you were called in today, right?
I heard it was for remedial P.E., but...

You barely show up to P.E., and you think
you can graduate from Mihoshi like that?!
I-I might not be able to~
Not "might"! I won't LET you graduate!!

rows.notes: 'oni de wa nai' = I'm not a demon / not heartless.

rows.en: You're free to pick your own special training!!

rows.notes: Choices parody a food order: oomori / tokumori / A-set.

rows.en: Set A (50 laps of the field)
Not bad, you kept up with me...
Keep this up and move your body every day!

(I did just as much exercise as he did...
Is Gary-sensei immortal or something...?)
I heard it was for remedial P.E., though...

rows.notes: moyashikko written with the 'girl' kanji in the female version.

rows.en: Set A (25 laps of the field)
Here we go! 25 laps of the field!!!

(He did twice as much exercise as me...
Is Gary-sensei immortal or what...?)
